title: Ejara Admin Panel — User Management Module Test Plan (v2)
scope: Accounts list (status tabs, search, filters, pagination, export entry point), Account details (profile panel, actions menu, KYC and account-status states, Products overview, Payment methods, Security/MFA), and every manual operation designed in Figma: Add / Deactivate payment method, Deactivate one or all MFA methods, Update email, Update phone, Deactivate, Activate, Freeze and Delete account. Customer Service (CS) admin profile.
deferred: Export file contents (no export screen), Unfreeze flow and payment-method reactivation (referenced but no frames), Change user type modal (disabled for CS), Accounts list filter panel (not designed; tested against product's confirmed fields), audit-log screens (none designed).
designNotes: Values on Figma screens are representative only: tests check structure, labels, behaviour and consistency, not the sample names or amounts.

Figma now designs Freeze, Delete and the 2-step Activate flow, the "..." menu (Deactivate / Freeze / Delete) and 4 KYC states. v1 listed these as "not designed"; sections 14–16 and the new section 3 cases cover them.
MFA, payment-method and account-status flows are Details → Review details with no admin OTP step in Figma; v1 cases that assumed an OTP step are updated or set to manual.

Design defects to raise with design: TOTP copy on every Review callout; "Reason for deactivation" on the Activate flow; account-deactivation warning reused on payment-method deactivation; "Add the agent username." under every Delete option; "froozen" / "Froozen" spellings; truncated KYC alert body; "Update details" breadcrumb on the Add payment method code step; list tab "Active" vs badge "Confirmed".

State-changing cases (Freeze, Delete, Deactivate/Activate, MFA, payment methods, email/phone) only run with PHX_ALLOW_ACCOUNT_OPS=true and a disposable test account per flow; otherwise they are reported as Skipped with the missing requirement.

sections.name: Accounts List
sections.pre: Agent is logged into the Admin Panel with a Customer Service (CS) role; User management > Accounts list (/users) is open.

cases.title: Accounts list page loads with correct heading and subtitle
steps: Navigate to User management.
cases.expected: Heading "Accounts" and subtitle "Let agents locate the right user quickly, with enough summary information to triage before opening the full account detail." are shown; breadcrumb shows the User management icon.
cases.note: Expected copy taken from Figma 1148:90703.

cases.title: Empty state when there are zero user accounts
steps: Navigate to User management in an environment/dataset with no user accounts.
cases.expected: Table area shows a clear empty-state message/illustration instead of a blank table or an error.
cases.pre: Admin logged into the Ejara Admin Panel with valid support-agent credentials; User management > Accounts list page is open in a test environment/dataset with zero user accounts.

cases.title: Phase tabs Active, Frozen, Deactivated, Deleted are present and mutually exclusive
steps: Observe the tab row above the accounts table.
cases.expected: Four status tabs are shown in this order: Active, Frozen, Deactivated, Deleted (Figma). Exactly one is selected and the first one is the default. Status naming: Figma uses "Active" for the list tab and "Confirmed" for the profile badge. Flag if the build uses a different label for the first tab.
cases.note: Assert the Figma label and report the live label. v1 note: Naming inconsistency confirmed in the design: this list tab reads "Active", while the account detail screen's status badge for the same state reads "Confirmed". Needs reconciling with design/product — this plan uses "Active" for the list tab and "Confirmed" for the detail-page badge throughout, matching each screen's actual literal text, until the two are unified.

cases.title: Table columns display in correct order
steps: Observe the accounts table header on the Active tab.
cases.expected: Columns in order: select-all checkbox, Username, Full name, Email address, Phone number, Country, then a "See details" action column.

cases.title: Each row displays a "See details" link
steps: Observe each row in the table.
cases.expected: Every row has a functional "See details" link at the far right.

cases.title: Switching to the Frozen tab shows only frozen accounts
steps: Click the "Frozen" tab.
cases.expected: Table refreshes to show only accounts whose status is Frozen; other tabs' accounts are not shown.

cases.title: Switching to the Deactivated and Deleted tabs filters accordingly
steps: Click the "Deactivated" tab, then the "Deleted" tab.
cases.expected: "Deactivated" shows only deactivated accounts and "Deleted" shows only deleted accounts; the URL/status filter follows the selected tab.

cases.title: Search filters the account list by username
steps: Type a known username (e.g. @rosetestbox) into the search box and press Enter.
cases.expected: List updates to show only accounts whose username matches the search term.

cases.title: Search also matches on full name, email and phone number
steps: Search with a known full name, then its email address, then its phone number.
cases.expected: Each search returns the matching account, confirming Search covers more than just username.
cases.note: Now automated: each search must return the same account. v1 note: Unconfirmed: the search scope beyond username was not visible in the delivered screens — verify which fields are actually indexed once implemented.

cases.title: Search with no matching account shows an empty state
steps: Type a value that matches no account into the search field.
cases.expected: Table shows a clear empty state ("No data" illustration or an accounts-specific message) instead of stale rows; result counter reads 0 results.

cases.title: Refresh icon reloads the account list
steps: Click the refresh/reload icon next to the search bar.
cases.expected: List reloads current data for the active tab.

cases.title: Filters button opens the Filter by panel
steps: Click the "Filters" button.
cases.expected: A side panel titled "Filter by" slides in for narrowing the account list.

cases.title: Export button is present on the Accounts list
steps: Click the "Export" button.
cases.expected: Export button is visible next to Filters. The export file itself is deferred (no export screen designed).
cases.note: Export flow not designed: only the entry point is tested.

cases.title: Pagination controls behave as in other modules
steps: Change "Per page" and navigate using page numbers and arrows.
cases.expected: Per page selector and page numbers/arrows work; previous arrow is disabled on page 1; the counter reads "Showing X to Y of Z results" with correct numbers (e.g. "Showing 1 to 20 of 135 results").
cases.note: v1 note: Pagination result counter's stray comma (e.g. "Showing 1 to 8 of, 500 results") is the same known cross-app copy defect noted in prior modules — correct silently, not a new finding.

cases.title: Clicking a username or "See details" opens the correct Account details
steps: Click "See details" on a specific row (e.g. @delasap001).
cases.expected: Admin is navigated to Account details for @delasap001, defaulting to the Products overview tab, with matching name/email/phone.

cases.title: Row-level and header checkboxes support multi-select on the accounts table
steps: Click the header checkbox, then an individual row checkbox.
cases.expected: Header checkbox selects/deselects all visible rows; individual row checkboxes toggle independently.

cases.title: Search box placeholder reads "Search account..."
steps: Look at the search box.
cases.expected: Placeholder reads "Search account..." (Figma 1148:90703).

cases.title: Result counter shows a valid range on page 1
steps: Open the Accounts list.
Read the result counter.
cases.expected: Counter reads "Showing 1 to N of Z results" with 1 ≤ N ≤ Z (never negative or "-19 to 0").

cases.title: Page 2 shows the next rows and the counter follows
steps: Click page "2".
cases.expected: Rows change; counter starts at (page size + 1); page 2 is the active page.

cases.title: Each status tab keeps its own URL and result count
steps: Click Frozen, Deactivated, Deleted in turn.
Note the URL and counter each time.
cases.expected: Each tab sets its own status (e.g. ?status=frozen / deactivated / deleted) and its own result count.

cases.title: Deleted tab rows do not open as active accounts
steps: Open "See details" on a Deleted-tab row.
cases.expected: Account details shows the red banner "This account has been deleted!" and a "Deleted" badge (Figma 1615:111592).

cases.title: Clearing the search restores the full list
steps: Search for a username.
Clear the search box and press Enter.
cases.expected: Full list and its original result count come back.

cases.title: Rows show "-" (not "null") for missing values
steps: Scan the Full name / Email columns on every tab.
cases.expected: Missing values show "-"; the raw text "null" never appears in a cell.

sections.name: Accounts List Filters
sections.figma: not designed for User Management (Country + Registration date confirmed by product)

cases.title: Filter by panel opens with Country and Registration date fields
steps: Open the Filters panel from the Accounts list.
cases.expected: Panel "Filter by" opens with a Country selector and a Registration date range (start/end), plus Reset and Apply filters (confirmed by product; no Figma frame yet).

Suggest also considering a User type filter (Client vs. other types seen in the profile panel) or a KYC/verification status filter, since both are already surfaced elsewhere on Account details and would help agents triage — flag as a suggestion for Serge, not a requirement.

cases.title: The Country filter returns only matching accounts
steps: Select a country and apply filters.
cases.expected: Account list shows only accounts whose Country matches the selection.

cases.title: The Registration date range filter returns accounts within the selected range
steps: Select a start and end date and apply filters.
cases.expected: Account list shows only accounts registered within the selected range.

cases.title: Combining Country and Registration date applies AND logic
steps: Set both filter fields and apply filters.
cases.expected: Returned accounts satisfy both selected criteria simultaneously.

cases.title: "Reset" clears all filter fields
steps: Set several filter values, then click "Reset".
cases.expected: All filter fields clear back to their default empty state.

cases.title: Filters apply within the currently selected phase tab
steps: Switch to the "Frozen" tab, then apply a filter.
cases.expected: Filter is applied only to Frozen-tab accounts; switching back to Active shows the Active tab's own (unfiltered) list.

cases.title: Closing the filter panel without applying discards unsaved selections
steps: Enter filter values, then close the panel via the X icon without applying.
cases.expected: Account list remains in its previously applied (or default) state; unsaved selections are discarded.

cases.title: Export from a filtered view exports only the filtered subset
steps: Apply a filter, then click "Export".
cases.expected: Downloaded file contains only the filtered subset of accounts.

cases.title: An agent without Export permission does not see the Export button
steps: Log in as an agent role without Export permission.
cases.expected: Export button is hidden or disabled for this role.

cases.title: Apply filters is disabled until at least one criterion is set
steps: Open the panel with no filter values entered.
cases.expected: "Apply filters" is disabled until at least one filter value is provided.

sections.name: Account Details — Profile panel, actions and KYC states

cases.title: The profile panel shows avatar, verified tick, full name, Confirmed badge, and username with copy icon

cases.expected: Panel shows avatar initials with a KYC tick, full name, a "Confirmed" status badge, and the username with a working copy icon.

cases.title: "Edit details" opens a menu with Email address and Phone number

cases.expected: A dropdown opens with two options: "Email address" and "Phone number" (Figma 1525:119276 / 1536:125636). Each option starts its update flow.

cases.title: "Change user type" is disabled for the Customer Service (CS) profile

cases.title: "..." menu lists Deactivate account, Freeze account and Delete account
steps: Click the "..." button next to "Change user type".
cases.expected: Menu items in order: "Deactivate account", "Freeze account", "Delete account" (Delete in red) (Figma 1549:49711).

cases.title: The Personal Infos panel shows Email and Phone number with a verified-check badge when confirmed
steps: Observe the Email and Phone number rows in the Personal Infos panel for a fully-verified user.
cases.expected: Both fields show their value alongside a green check badge indicating confirmed/verified status.

cases.title: Email shows a warning icon instead of a check when the address is unverified
steps: Open Account details for a user whose email is not yet verified.
cases.expected: Email shows a red warning icon instead of the green check when the address is not verified (Figma "Not KYC" frame 1498:102393).

cases.title: Not-verified account shows the "This user hasn't verified yet!" alert with a link to KYC

cases.expected: Dismissible info alert titled "This user hasn't verified yet!" with a "Go to KYC page" link to the Kyc & Comp. module (Figma 1498:102393).
cases.note: v1 note: The exact copy captured from the design ("go th[rough]...") reads as truncated/unfinished placeholder text — worth a light copy pass, though not a functional defect. Also confirms module scope: KYC/compliance review itself lives in the separate Kyc & Comp. module — this screen only surfaces the alert and links out, it doesn't manage verification itself.

cases.title: The alert can be dismissed and does not block interacting with the rest of the page
steps: Dismiss the unverified or deactivated alert via its close control.
cases.expected: Alert closes on its X; the rest of the page stays usable.

cases.title: Personal Infos panel shows Date of birth, Gender, Country of citizenship, Country of residence, Referral code
steps: Observe the remaining fields in the User section of the panel.
cases.expected: All five fields are present and correctly populated; Referral code has a working copy icon.

cases.title: The Company section shows User type, Company, Created by, Created at
steps: Observe the Company section below the divider in the Personal Infos panel.
cases.expected: All four fields are present and correctly populated, with "Created by" showing the creating agent's @username.

cases.title: The Personal Infos panel remains visible and unchanged across all three tabs
steps: Switch between Products overview, Payment methods, and Security tabs.
cases.expected: The profile/Personal Infos panel on the right stays visible and its content is unchanged across all tabs.

cases.title: Deep-linking directly to an Account details URL loads the correct account
steps: Navigate directly to an Account details URL for a known username without going through the list first.
cases.expected: Correct account's details load directly, defaulting to Products overview.

cases.title: Account details for a user with no active products shows an appropriate empty state on Products overview
steps: Open Account details for a user who has not activated any Wallet/Savings/Goal/Bond product.
cases.expected: Products overview tab shows an appropriate empty state instead of blank or broken cards.

cases.title: An agent without Manual Operations permission does not see edit/deactivate actions
steps: Log in as an agent role without Manual Operations permission and open Account details.
cases.expected: "Edit details", the "..." menu's action items, and other mutating actions are hidden or disabled for this role.

cases.title: Page title/browser tab reflects the currently viewed account
steps: Observe the browser tab title while viewing Account details.
cases.expected: Browser tab title refers to the account (e.g. "@username — Account details"). Generic titles ("Account overview") are flagged.

cases.title: Left-nav User management item highlights when on any Account details page
steps: Navigate to Account details from the Accounts list.
cases.expected: "User management" remains highlighted as the active section in the left nav.

cases.title: Account details pages render correctly at common desktop resolutions
steps: Load Account details at 1280px, 1440px, and 1920px widths.
cases.expected: Layout remains usable with no overlapping or clipped elements at any tested width, including the fixed-width Personal Infos panel.

cases.title: Username copy icon copies the username
steps: Click the copy icon next to the username.
cases.expected: Clipboard holds the username shown in the panel.

cases.title: Referral code copy icon copies the referral code
steps: Click the copy icon next to Referral code.
cases.expected: Clipboard holds the referral code shown.

cases.title: KYC pending account shows "Identity verification is pending!"
steps: Open an account whose KYC was submitted and is under review.
cases.expected: Orange alert "Identity verification is pending!" with "Go to KYC page"; orange avatar badge (Figma 1519:111001).
cases.pre: Account with KYC submitted (PHX_UM_KYC_PENDING_USERNAME).

cases.title: KYC rejected account shows "Identity verification has been rejected!"
steps: Open an account whose KYC was rejected.
cases.expected: Red alert "Identity verification has been rejected!" with "Go to KYC page"; red avatar badge (Figma 1519:107609).
cases.pre: Account with KYC rejected (PHX_UM_KYC_REJECTED_USERNAME).

cases.title: KYC-verified account shows no verification alert
steps: Open a KYC-verified account.
cases.expected: No KYC alert; green avatar tick; email and phone show green checks (Figma 1498:97974).
cases.pre: KYC-verified account (PHX_UM_USERNAME).

cases.title: KYC alert copy is complete and correctly spelled
steps: Open an account that shows any KYC alert.
Read the alert body.
cases.expected: Body text is a full sentence. Design feedback: Figma reads "You can reach to him, or go th" (cut off). Flag typos such as "You ca reach to him".

cases.title: "Go to KYC page" opens this user in Kyc & Comp.
steps: Click "Go to KYC page" on the KYC alert.
cases.expected: The Kyc & Comp. module opens on this user's KYC request.

cases.title: Change user type is visible but disabled
steps: Look at the action buttons.
cases.expected: "Change user type" is shown greyed out and cannot be clicked (CS profile).
cases.note: Split from USR-DET-005 so the disabled state is checked on its own.

cases.title: Frozen account shows the blue banner and a Frozen badge
steps: Open a Frozen account.
cases.expected: Blue banner "This account has been frozen!" with "See details"; badge "Frozen"; no action buttons. Design feedback: Figma spells it "froozen" (1611:46367).
cases.pre: Any account on the Frozen tab.

cases.title: Deleted account shows the red banner and a Deleted badge
steps: Open a Deleted account.
cases.expected: Red banner "This account has been deleted!" with "See details"; badge "Deleted"; no action buttons (Figma 1615:111592).
cases.pre: Any account on the Deleted tab.

sections.name: Account Details — Products overview tab
sections.pre: Agent has opened Account details for a Confirmed (active) account with Wallet, Savings box, Goal savings and Bond investment positions; Products overview tab is shown.

cases.title: Products overview is the default tab on Account details
steps: Open Account details for any confirmed account.
cases.expected: The "Products overview" tab is selected/active by default when the page loads.

cases.title: The Wallet card shows Total balance and Status, with a working View details link
steps: Observe the Wallet card and click "View details".
cases.expected: Card shows Total balance in XAF and a Status badge (e.g. Active); "View details" navigates to the Wallet module for this user.

cases.title: The Savings box card shows Total balance, Cash bonus, and free-withdrawal availability
steps: Observe the Savings box card.
cases.expected: Card titled "Savings box" shows Total balance, Cash bonus (green) and "NN free withdrawal available" (Figma: "01 free withdrawal available").

cases.title: The Goal savings card shows Total balance, Cash bonus, a segmented progress bar, and a per-goal breakdown
steps: Observe the Goal savings card for a user with multiple goals.
cases.expected: Card shows Total balance, Cash bonus, a multi-segment bar representing each goal's share, and a legend listing each goal with its amount (e.g. "Buy a car — 150,652 XAF").

cases.title: The Bond investment card shows Total balance, Total interests, a progress bar, and a per-bond breakdown
steps: Observe the Bond investment card for a user with one or more bonds.
cases.expected: Card shows Total balance, Total interests (in green), a progress bar, and a legend listing each bond with its invested amount (e.g. "OTA Cameroon — 2,000 XAF").

cases.title: Each card's "Total of NN <item>(s)" summary line matches the number of legend rows shown
steps: Count the legend rows on the Goal savings and Bond investment cards and compare to the "Total of NN goal(s)"/bond(s) text.
cases.expected: Counts match exactly.

cases.title: "View details" on the Goal savings card navigates to that user's Goal savings records
steps: Click "View details" on the Goal savings card.
cases.expected: Admin is navigated to the Goal savings module, scoped to this user.

cases.title: "View details" on the Bond investment card navigates to that user's Bond investment records
steps: Click "View details" on the Bond investment card.
cases.expected: Admin is navigated to the Bond investment module, scoped to this user.

cases.title: The Wallet card's Status badge is the wallet's own status, distinct from the account-level status
steps: Compare the Wallet card's Status badge (e.g. "Active") with the account-level status badge in the profile panel (e.g. "Confirmed").
cases.expected: These are two separate concepts that happen to use similar wording — the Wallet card's "Active" describes the wallet product itself, not the account. Confirm both can vary independently (e.g. a wallet could theoretically show a different status while the account itself is Confirmed/Active) rather than assuming they're the same field displayed twice.
cases.note: v1 note: Worth flagging to avoid confusion during test authorship and execution: "Active" appears in at least three different contexts in this module (accounts-list tab, Wallet card status, and potentially others) — make sure each is verified against its own data source, not conflated.

cases.title: The Goal savings card shows an empty state when the user has no goals

cases.title: A product with zero balance still renders its card without error
steps: Open Products overview for a user with a Wallet balance of 0 XAF.

cases.title: Currency formatting is consistent across all four product cards

cases.title: Deactivated banner is visible from the Products overview tab

cases.note: v1 note: Confirmed defect (per the audited spec, not the general reused-copy convention used elsewhere): this callout currently shows mismatched placeholder copy about resetting TOTP/MFA, which looks like a leftover from a different flow. Unlike the equivalent callouts in Savings Box/Bond Investment/Update Email/Phone (which are accurate references to an admin's own TOTP setup), this one has been confirmed as wrong and needs correcting by design before build.

cases.title: Back from the Review step preserves the entered reason
steps: From the Review step, click "Back".
cases.expected: Admin returns to the Details step with the previously entered reason still populated.
cases.pre: Agent is on the Confirmation code or Review details step of this flow.

cases.title: The final action reads "Deactivate account" and is styled as destructive
steps: Observe the primary button on the Review details step.
cases.expected: Primary button reads "Deactivate account" and is red; a "Back" button sits next to it.
cases.pre: Agent is on the Confirmation code or Review details step of this flow.

cases.title: No admin OTP step: Review details is the last step
steps: Click "Deactivate account" on the Review step and observe what happens next.
cases.expected: Figma shows Details → Review details only. Flag if the build adds an OTP step.
cases.note: v1 open question answered by Figma (2 steps). v1 note: Open question: the audited spec describes Deactivate as a genuine two-step wizard (Details → Review) with no OTP frame mentioned, unlike Update Email/Phone (which explicitly includes a Confirmation/OTP step) and the general admin-TOTP pattern used in other modules (Savings Box, Bond Investment). This may be an intentional exception — reason capture plus a destructive-styled button may be considered sufficient friction for this action — or a step simply not captured in the static export. Confirm against a live build before asserting either way.

cases.title: A successful deactivation moves the account to the Deactivated tab
steps: Complete and confirm the deactivation.
cases.expected: Account no longer appears under the Active tab and now appears under the Deactivated tab on the Accounts list.

cases.title: Deactivated account shows the orange banner with "See details" and a Deactivated badge
steps: Open Account details for the newly-deactivated account.

cases.pre: Admin is viewing Account details for a Deactivated account.
cases.note: v1 note: The exact copy captured from the design ("go th[rough]...") reads as truncated/unfinished placeholder text — worth a light copy pass, though not a functional defect.

cases.title: Edit details and Change user type actions are hidden or disabled for a Deactivated account
steps: Observe the Actions row in the profile panel.
cases.expected: Both buttons are hidden/disabled, consistent with the account being deactivated.
cases.pre: Admin is viewing Account details for a Deactivated account.

cases.title: The completed deactivation is logged with operator ID, timestamp, and reason
steps: Check the audit trail after a successful deactivation, if accessible.
cases.expected: Log entry captures the agent, timestamp, and the reason given for deactivation.

cases.title: A Deactivated account can still be located and opened via Search on the Deactivated tab
steps: Search for the newly-deactivated account's username on the Deactivated tab.
cases.expected: Account is found and its details open normally in the deactivated (read-restricted) state.

cases.title: Cancel on the Details step returns to Account details unchanged
steps: Open the Deactivate flow.
Click Cancel.
cases.expected: Agent is back on Account details; badge still "Confirmed".
cases.note: Non-destructive companion to USR-DEACT-004.

cases.title: Close (X) and "Do you need help?" are in the flow header
steps: Open the Deactivate flow.
cases.expected: Header shows "Do you need help?" and an X that leaves the flow without changes.

sections.name: Manual operation — Activate (reactivate) account
sections.figma: 1667:129603 and 1691:161782 (Deactivated → See details → Details → Review details → Activated)
sections.pre: Agent is on Account details of a Deactivated account.

cases.title: "See details" on the deactivated banner opens a Details side panel with "Activate account"
steps: Open Account details for a Deactivated account and locate the deactivated alert.
cases.expected: Side panel "Details" shows Action "Deactivate account", Client, Updated at, Updated by (agent @username), Reason (eye toggle), an info box "If you've fixed the issue that caused your account to be deactivated, just hit the "Activate Account" button…", and a purple "Activate account" button (Figma 1667:136591).
cases.note: v1 assumed an inline link in the alert; Figma now has a side panel + 2-step flow.

cases.title: "Activate account" starts a 2-step flow (Details → Review details)
steps: Click "Activate this account".
cases.expected: Full-page flow: breadcrumb "@<username> / Activate account", stepper Details → Review details, a reason textarea (Figma 1667:140152). Design feedback: the label reads "Reason for deactivation" on the activate flow.
cases.note: v1 note: Open question: confirm with design/product whether this asymmetry with Deactivate (which requires a reason and a Review step) is intentional — a lightweight reversal of what was itself a lightweight suspension — or a gap that should be brought up to the same audit standard before build.

cases.title: Review shows Action "Activate account" and the button "Activate account"
steps: Click "Activate this account" and observe what, if anything, appears before the status changes.
cases.expected: Review lists Action "Activate account", Client, Date, Reason; purple "Activate account" + "Back" (Figma 1667:140185). No OTP step.
cases.note: v1 note: Not shown in the audited frames — no confirmation step was captured for this action. Verify against a live build rather than assuming either way.

cases.title: A successful activation moves the account back to the Active tab
steps: Complete the Activate action.
cases.expected: Account moves from the Deactivated tab back to the first (Active/Confirmed) tab; profile badge reads "Confirmed" (Figma 1691:161839).

cases.title: The deactivated-account alert disappears once the account is reactivated
steps: Open Account details for the newly-reactivated account.
cases.expected: No deactivated alert is shown; product cards and profile panel render in their normal (non-restricted) state.

cases.title: Edit details and Change user type actions reappear for a reactivated account
steps: Observe the Actions row in the profile panel after reactivation.
cases.expected: Edit details, Change user type (still disabled for CS) and "..." are shown again.

cases.title: A reactivated account's payment methods and MFA settings are unaffected by the deactivate/reactivate cycle
steps: Compare Payment methods and Security tab state before deactivation and after reactivation.
cases.expected: Payment methods and MFA toggle states are preserved exactly as they were before deactivation.

cases.title: The completed activation is logged with operator ID and timestamp
steps: Check the audit trail after a successful reactivation, if accessible.
cases.expected: Log entry captures the agent and timestamp of the reactivation.

cases.title: Details side panel closes with its X
steps: Open "See details" on the deactivated banner.
Click X.
cases.expected: Panel closes; account stays Deactivated.

cases.title: Activate flow reason label matches the action
steps: Open the activate flow.
Read the textarea label.
cases.expected: Label is about activation (e.g. "Reason for activation"). Design feedback: Figma 1667:140169 reads "Reason for deactivation".

cases.title: Activate flow breadcrumb and stepper are consistent
steps: Open the activate flow.
cases.expected: Breadcrumb "@<username> / Activate account"; stepper "Details → Review details". Design feedback: the second Figma variant (1691:161996) shows breadcrumb "Deactivate account" and step "User information".

cases.title: Activation requires a reason
steps: Open the activate flow.
Leave the reason empty.
cases.expected: "Review details" stays disabled until a reason is entered.

Choose "Freeze account".

cases.title: Review details is disabled until a reason is entered

Type a reason.

cases.title: Cancel leaves the account Confirmed

Click Cancel.
cases.expected: Back on Account details; status unchanged.

cases.title: Review shows Action "Freeze account", client, date and reason
steps: Enter a reason.
Click Review details.

cases.title: Back from Review keeps the reason

cases.title: Confirming freezes the account

cases.expected: Account moves to the Frozen tab; badge "Frozen"; blue banner "This account has been frozen!" with "See details"; action buttons hidden (Figma 1611:46367).

cases.title: Frozen banner "See details" shows who froze it and why

cases.title: Unfreeze is offered for a frozen account

steps: Freeze a test account.
Try a deposit and a login from the customer app.

cases.title: Freeze is recorded in the audit trail
steps: Check the audit trail after freezing.
cases.expected: Entry with agent, timestamp and reason.

cases.title: Consistent XAF currency formatting across all Account details product cards
steps: Compare currency value formatting across Wallet, Savings box, Goal savings, and Bond investment cards.
cases.expected: All monetary values use consistent, correctly-grouped thousands separators and the "XAF" suffix throughout.

cases.expected: All dates use the same consistent format, e.g. "July 02, 2024 - 12:00 AM".

cases.title: The confirmation-badge styling (green check) for Email and Phone is used consistently across every tab that shows it
steps: Compare the confirmation badges on Products overview, Payment methods, and Security tabs.
cases.expected: Same badge styling and behaviour on every tab, since the Personal Infos panel is shared.

cases.title: The two distinct confirmation-flow step orders in this module are each internally consistent

cases.expected: Update email/phone and Add payment method: Details/Contact info → Confirmation code (customer) → Review. Deactivate/Freeze/Activate/MFA/payment method: Details → Review. Delete: Account details → Reason for deletion → Review. No flow mixes the patterns.

cases.title: Left-nav "User management" item has no sub-menu, unlike other modules

cases.expected: "User management" is a single sidebar link (no sub-menu) and is highlighted on /users pages.

cases.title: Keyboard Tab order through each Manual Operations wizard is logical
steps: Use Tab to move through the Update Email/Phone and deactivation flow fields.
cases.expected: Focus moves in a logical order through all interactive fields and buttons in each flow.

cases.title: Session/OTP expiry mid-Manual-Operation is handled gracefully across all flows in this module
steps: Simulate a session or OTP expiry while on a Review or Confirmation step of any Manual operation in this module.
cases.expected: Admin is prompted to re-authenticate without silently losing entered data or applying a duplicate/partial change.
cases.pre: Agent is on the Confirmation code or Review details step of this flow.

cases.title: User Management pages render correctly at common desktop resolutions
steps: Load Accounts list and Account details at 1280px, 1440px, and 1920px widths.
cases.expected: Layout remains usable with no overlapping or clipped elements at any tested width, including the four-card Products overview grid.

cases.title: All confirmed defects and open observations from Section 3 of this document are re-tested once addressed
steps: After a fix or confirmation is provided for any item logged in the Design & Copy Observations section, re-run the corresponding TC ID(s).
cases.expected: Each previously-flagged item passes (or its expected result is updated) once resolved.

cases.expected: Callout explains what will happen. Design feedback: all Figma Review frames show "Just reach out to one of your admins to reset your TOTP setup, and then you can update it."
